description: Dialog shell of the item and table-cell editors (Fáze 9): one core TmModal (a full-height bottom sheet with a sticky footer on a phone), the type-specific fields, the localized validation messages and a live preview of the item being edited.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: The type-specific fields, bound to the caller's copy.

parameters.name: PreviewContent
parameters.description: The live preview of the edited copy (optional).

parameters.name: Errors
parameters.description: The localized validation messages; an invalid item cannot be saved.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user saves the copy (only reachable while the form is valid).

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised on Cancel, Escape and an overlay click — the copy is thrown away.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the dialog read-only: Save is disabled and the copy can never be applied.
